title: unified-rollouts-canary-ab-shadow-autorollback-observability-enhancements
author: Maya Patel
release_notes: Enhances rollback observability for canary/AB/shadow rollouts: adds rollback reason histograms, alerting hooks, and dashboards; no user-facing API changes.
description: Context: Our canary/AB/shadow autorollback engine has matured but incident postmortems show gaps in observability that make diagnosing why an automated rollback fired time-consuming. This PR adds structured telemetry, dashboards, and stability guards to make rollback decisions transparent to SREs and product teams. Motivation: Faster triage, fewer false-positive rollbacks, and clearer model-lifecycle economics. Changes include: - Add histogram metrics for rollback triggers (rollback_reasons_bucket) and a labeled counter per-policy (rollback_trigger_count{policy,reason}). - Add per-rollout trace spans and tags for canary/AB/shadow stages to make trace-based investigation easier. - Emit structured events to the audit pipeline for every automated rollback with metadata (rollout_id, policy, metric_snapshot, candidate_model). - Wire metric-based alerts (Prometheus rules) and Grafana dashboard panels for quick triage. - Add stability guards: a short-term debounce window and minimum sample quorum before autorollback is allowed for shadow-only probes. - Add unit and e2e coverage for new telemetry paths and quarantine behavior. Checklist: - [x] Instrument metrics and traces - [x] Audit event schema and kafka producer - [x] Dashboard + alert rules (dev and prod) - [x] Unit tests - [x] Integration e2e tests on perf-canary cluster - [x] Docs snippet for rollout observability (redwood-docs) See related Linear items ENG-5423 and ENG-5789 and incident SUP-312. No breaking API changes.
